name: [Cyanotype] Storage integrity check has open findings
message:
{{#is_alert}}The nightly storage integrity check has findings: a photo whose original is missing, an object no photo points at, or an original that no longer matches its checksum.{{/is_alert}}
Open Admin > Health > Storage integrity to see which. Missing originals and mismatches can usually be restored from a previous version of the object; untracked objects can be restored as photos or deleted. Findings marked lost or left are not counted. See docs/admin.md, "Storage integrity".
